# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- Always read `CLAUDE.md` at the repository root before starting work on a thread, and follow it.
- Never deviate from the established architecture/design (e.g., replacing AXAML views with code-only C# controls) without asking first. If a file can't be created with tools, try other commands or tell the user the path so they create it, then edit it.
- Design changes properly and completely; do not rush or take shortcuts to finish quickly. Verify every edit actually persisted on disk before reporting it done.
